analysis_name: Pediatric Growth-Plate and Anatomical Error Analysis
findings: The object detector successfully filtered out normal open growth plates in 219 out of 251 normal pediatric radiographs (87.25% specificity), compared to only 1.59% specificity in Experiment 4 and 0.40% in Experiment 3. By supervising with bounding boxes rather than a whole-image binary flag, the network learns the distinct edge morphology of cortical disruption rather than firing on the natural radiolucency of distal radial/ulnar physes.
